lead.note: lead: to guide, go in front of, or be in charge; the front position; a clue; said like 'leed'
lead the metal (a heavy grey metal; the graphite 'lead' of a pencil), said like 'led'

row.note: row: a line of things side by side; to propel a boat with oars, rhymes with 'go'
row a noisy quarrel or argument, rhymes with 'cow'

does.note: does: the verb 'do' in the third person singular, rhymes with 'buzz'
does, the plural of 'doe': female deer, rabbits or hares, rhymes with 'goes'

sewer.note: sewer: an underground channel that carries waste water, said like 'SOO-er'
sewer as 'one who sews', said like 'so-er'

lower.note: lower: less high; to let down or reduce, rhymes with 'mower'
lower: to frown or look threatening (of the sky or a person), rhymes with 'flower'

slough.note: slough: a swamp or muddy hollow; a state of despair, rhymes with 'cow'
slough: to shed a layer of skin; to cast something off
slough: a swamp or muddy hollow, said like 'slew'

polish.note: polish: to rub until smooth and shiny; a substance for shining; refinement
Polish: of Poland, its people or language, said like 'poh-lish'

bass.note: bass: low in pitch; the low-pitched instrument or voice, said like 'base'

tear.note: tear: to rip or pull apart; a rip or hole, rhymes with 'air'
tear: a drop of liquid from the eye, rhymes with 'ear'

wound.note: wound: an injury to the body; to injure, said like 'woond'
wound: past tense of 'wind' (turned or twisted), rhymes with 'found'

dove.note: dove: American past tense of 'dive', rhymes with 'stove'

bow.note: bow: the weapon for arrows; a knot with loops; the stick for a violin, rhymes with 'go'
bow: to bend forward from the waist; the front of a ship, rhymes with 'now'

sow.note: sow: to plant seeds, rhymes with 'go'
sow: an adult female pig, rhymes with 'cow'

minute.note: minute: a unit of time, 60 seconds; a short record of a meeting

close.note: close: near, in space or time; a closed-in place, rhymes with 'dose'
close: to shut; to end, rhymes with 'nose'
